RESOURCE DROP Claude Code Status Bar Set it up once. Stop interrupting your builds. The Problem Every time you type /status, /usage, or /model mid-build, you're stopping to ask Claude Code: where am I? What branch? How much context have I used? That's three different commands that pull you out of flow — for information that should always be visible. The fix: A status line at the bottom of your terminal — folder, branch, model, context bar — always on, just like a health bar in a game. STEP 1 — QUICKEST SETUP The Exact Prompt Open Claude Code in your terminal and type this: / s t a t u s l i n e s h o w f o l d e r , g i t b r a n c h , m o d e l n a m e , a n d c o n t e x t p e r c e n t a g e w i t h a p r o g r e s s b a r That's it. Claude Code generates and installs the script automatically. You'll see: • Your current working folder • Git branch you're on • Which Claude model is active (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) • Context window percentage with a visual progress bar — so you know when Claude is about to forget earlier work STEP 2 — MANUAL CONFIG (OPTIONAL) If You Want Full Control For advanced users who want to customise the script manually: 1. Open your settings file

~ / . c l a u d e / s e t t i n g s . j s o n 2. Add the statusLine block { " s t a t u s L i n e " : { " t y p e " : " c o m m a n d " , " c o m m a n d " : " ~ / . c l a u d e / s t a t u s l i n e . s h " , " p a d d i n g " : 0 } } 3. How it works Claude Code passes live session data into your script via stdin as JSON — including model, current directory, context cost, and more. Your script reads it and outputs one formatted line. Refresh rate: Updates every time conversation messages update, at most every 300ms. ANSI colour codes are fully supported for styling. COMMUNITY GITHUB REPOS Cool Status Lines to Explore These go beyond the basics — themes, rate limit tracking, cost monitoring, powerline support, and more. Repo What it does sirmalloc/ccstatusline Z ero C onfig · npm Zero-config TUI setup wizard. Powerline support, themes, context bar, session & weekly usage, cost tracking. Easiest to install. daniel3303/ClaudeCodeStatusLine Ask C laude to install Just ask Claude to clone and install it. Shows model, tokens, rate limits, git info. Colour-coded: green → yellow → orange → red as context fills. tmck-code/yet-another-statusline Plugin marketplace · T hemes Available via Claude plugin marketplace. Multiple themes (claude-dark, catppuccin-mocha, latte). Automatically adapts layout to terminal width. nilbuild/claude-statusline Minimal Minimal and lightweight. Shows limits, directory, and git info. Backs up existing statusline config before installing — safe to try. Haleclipse/CCometixLine Rust · H igh performance High-performance statusline written in Rust. Git integration, usage tracking, interactive TUI config. Compiles to a single binary, cross-platform. These are third-party community projects. Read the repo and installation steps before running scripts or plugins inside your terminal environment.

# Page 3^page=3
OFFICIAL DOCUMENTATION Anthropic Docs — Status Line Config The official page covers the /statusline command, settings.json setup, the full JSON input structure Claude passes to your script (model, cwd, cost, session ID, and more), and example bash scripts. → docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/statusline PRO TIPS Context warning: Some community setups change the icon or colour at 70%+ context so you know exactly when to run /compact or /clear — before Claude starts forgetting earlier work. Commands you can retire: Once your status bar is live, you can stop typing /status, /usage, and /model mid-build. It's all in the bar. Settings location: ~/.claude/settings.json — hand-edit at any time. The statusLine.command is just a path to any executable script. Follow @byarnieverma for more Claude Code tips
